test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1b7035a6ece267f56f94e244dddf46e2fb2a80012cb208d9f886fa867bb852d.png]
solution:
When we compare both the figures we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58c06b10b0ad2bb1cd411c429c6c82fb75e01340f6dcd2d79f8667d750084879.png] 

We observe that, when we move the dice downwards towards right such that 4 and 6 are visible we find that on the left we have 2 and on the right we have 5 which means they both are opposite to each other. So **5** is the number on the face opposite the face showing 2.

Hence the correct answer is option 4)
